purpose: Prevent repair work from appearing interrupted by requiring every bounded tranche to close its evidence/review/synthesis loop before unrelated work begins.
invariants: A tranche may advance only one stage at a time from durable evidence.
AUTHORED without WIRED is an engineering delivery defect, not completed progress.
WIRED without visible executable evidence is EVIDENCE_VISIBILITY_GAP, not PASS or FAIL.
EXECUTED candidate evidence is non-formal and cannot replace W03/W04 or LCR-C.
W03 adjudicates behavior/personality contamination only after exact executable evidence is bound.
W04 synthesizes current W02/W03 only; stale synthesis cannot close a tranche.
Unrelated new repair work is blocked while a P0/HIGH tranche is between AUTHORED and W04_SYNTHESIZED, unless formal authority changes or the tranche is durably BLOCKED.
Every blocked stage must record exact blocker, owner, release condition, and next executable action.
Every stage transition writes latest-only checkpoint and fresh readback before reporting.
Heartbeat, poll, retry, workflow age, stage age, maintenance and self-test duration are zero Experience.
P_base, Identity, Personality and Governance remain read-only in this non-formal protocol.
